quarterly_data.quarter: Naver press release: NAVER Map Launches Place Agent, Enabling One-Stop Place (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NAVER release (09-17-2026): NAVER launched Place Agent in the NAVER Map app, an AI conversational search feature for finding places that recommends restaurants, cafes, hotels, salons and other places from the conversation context and the user's location, supports multi-turn refinement, explains each recommendation from NAVER place data (business details, visitor and blog reviews, booking availability) and, for places on NAVER Booking, takes a reservation request (date, time, party size) in a single sentence. Available to logged-in users aged 14 and older; answers carry an AI-generated notice
